title: Infrastructure operations report and evidence query

view.description: A query view. extensions pages safe Arc machine extension metadata, not extra machines; metric must be all. Full collected evidence is retained in the report JSON.

resource_group.description: Case-insensitive exact local resource-group match; not KQL.

resource_name.description: Case-insensitive resource-name substring matched against fixed-scope inventory.

resource_id.description: Exact local ARM ID match within the configured subscription; never a request URL.

resource_type.description: Case-insensitive exact provider/type match against the supported infrastructure inventory.

metric.description: Exact normalized metric. Different service/guest semantics remain separate.

state.description: Resource assessment or signal state. observed means observations without a configured review flag, not proof of health.

severity.description: Only signals, timeline and actions accept this filter.

period.description: auto selects the previous UTC calendar month for a report and the last 24 hours for a query.

start_utc.description: Required only for custom; ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset. No more than 31 days.

end_utc.description: Required only for custom; after start_utc and no later than collection time.

grain.description: auto uses 5-minute bins up to 48 hours, otherwise hourly. At most 800 bins; no data truncation.

limit.description: Requested query page size; the default-serialized 3500-byte transport budget may return fewer rows.

offset.description: Query offset. Use next_offset; each live invocation is a fresh collection, not a stable stored cursor.
